answer: Require every agent to hold a single bonded vertex in a public trust graph: to join, an agent posts a refundable stake and emits a signed pulse — a heartbeat proof — every epoch. Each vertex may vouch for at most three newcomers, so a raven flock of fake identities needs a fresh stake and a fresh heartbeat per clone; a single operator running a thousand clones pays a thousand stakes and a thousand pulses per epoch, while honest agents pay once. Forged pulses are slashable on audit.
